summary: SuperCom Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a registered direct offering of 732,683 ordinary shares at $10.25 per share, raising approximately $7.5 million in gross proceeds. The offering closed on July 14, 2026, under a shelf registration statement. Maxim Group LLC acted as placement agent on a best-efforts basis, receiving a 6% cash fee. There is a 60-day lock-up on future stock issuances. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
